# The Numbers

> > The Numbers is the premier source for movie box office data, financial analysis, and entertainment industry tracking, providing comprehensive insights into theatrical releases and film performance.

The Numbers (operated by OpusData) offers detailed box office tracking, movie budgets, revenue analysis, and industry trends for film professionals, analysts, and enthusiasts. The platform aggregates daily domestic and international box office data, production information, and historical performance metrics across the entertainment industry.

## Key Topics

- box office tracking
- daily domestic box office
- movie business analytics
- entertainment data
- film industry metrics
- theatrical release performance
- box office revenue
- movie financial analysis
- OpusData
- film tracking
- entertainment industry trends
- production budgets
- weekend box office
